QUOTE: "`library/common.h:132` defines `MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS` unconditionally. Its doc comment says the library may access its structs' private members. 129 library files include `common.h`, so the whole library compiles with the real field names."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that the shared header common.h turns the opt-out on, so every library translation unit sees the real (plain) member names.
